notes:
## New features & enhancements

- The downloaded-shortcut panel says the same thing in half the words.
- Every dialog now scrolls inside itself instead of running off a short window.

## Bug fixes

- The shortcut button stayed on screen on machines that already had a Desktop shortcut: each update overwrote the launcher's answer with the one shipped in the archive.
- The page read that answer once, at boot, before the launcher had written it. It now reads again until it gets one.
- The downloaded-shortcut panel ran off the bottom of a short window, buttons and all.
